forbid.message:
Raw

decides the type scale a second time. Render copy through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (, or MutedText for secondary copy) so the catalog owns the scale.
Raw <span> decides the type scale a second time. Render copy through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (<Text as="span">, or MutedText for secondary copy) so the catalog owns the scale.
Raw <legend> decides the type scale a second time. Render the group's caption through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (<Text as="legend">) so the catalog owns the scale.
Raw <code> decides the type scale a second time. Render inline code through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (<Text as="code">) so the catalog owns the scale.

Raw <h1> decides the type scale a second time. Render headings through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (<Text as="h1" variant="heading">) — and note AuthLayout already owns this app's only level-1 heading.
Raw <h2> decides the type scale a second time. Render a card heading through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (<Text as="h2" variant="subheading" color="onCard">).
Raw <h3> decides the type scale a second time. Render headings through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (<Text as="h3" variant="...">).
Raw <h4> decides the type scale a second time. Render headings through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (<Text as="h4" variant="...">).
Raw <h5> decides the type scale a second time. Render headings through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (<Text as="h5" variant="...">).
Raw <h6> decides the type scale a second time. Render headings through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (<Text as="h6" variant="...">).

Raw <button> is a copy of the Button recipe that drifts on its own. Render controls through Button from @bc-solutions-coder/ui — it covers solid, outline, secondary, ghost and link treatments across four size steps, so a quiet control has a variant rather than a hand-rolled class string.

paths.name: @bc-solutions-coder/sdk/query
paths.message: A feature reaches the API through its own `features/<feature>/api.ts` seam, which is the enumerable list of endpoints the feature is allowed to call and the one place a regeneration lands. Re-export the generated artifact there and import it from `../api` (or `@features/<feature>` from a route).

paths.name: @bc-solutions-coder/sdk
paths.message: These three are the raw request functions whose screens deliberately do not adopt a generated {op}Mutation() factory — they still belong behind the feature's `api.ts` seam like every other endpoint. Pure helpers and DTO types (isSafeReturnUrl, buildExchangeTicketUrl, InvitationResponse) issue no request and stay on the barrel.

paths.name: @bc-solutions-coder/sdk
paths.message: Deleted with the module-global client. Build a per-request instance with createWallowSdk({ baseUrl }) and pass { client: sdk.client } to the generated operations; errors already arrive as WallowError, so nothing needs unwrapping.

paths.name: @tanstack/react-query
paths.message: Import it from @bc-solutions-coder/query instead. The facade owns the pinned version and the shared client defaults, and keeps one QueryClient context instance across the workspace so a provider mounted in one package is the one every other package's hooks read.

paths.name: @bc-solutions-coder/web-shell
paths.message: @bc-solutions-coder/web-shell is deleted. createQueryClient now ships from @bc-solutions-coder/query, which also re-exports the react-query surface it used to wrap.

patterns.message: Import a published entry point instead: @bc-solutions-coder/sdk, /server, /server/passthrough, or /query. The dist and src layouts are internals and are not covered by the package's export contract.
The per-app SDK facade singletons are deleted. Read the request-scoped sdk off the router context (useRouteContext({ from: '__root__' }).sdk) instead of a module-global facade.
